visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a bright indoor living room, two young adults (a woman in a grey dress and a man in a black shirt) point toward an older man sitting on a grey sofa. (2) Following a brief static transition, the older man is seen alone on the sofa, holding a black remote control and drinking from a white ceramic mug while a black-and-white cat rests behind him. (3) The older man stands on a metal stepladder to reach a recessed ceiling light, while the young woman stands beside him with her hands near his waist for support. (4) The older man bends over to lift a large brown cardboard box and a pink plastic bag filled with items from the floor. (5) He walks toward a door carrying the heavy box; the young woman follows and opens the dark wood door for him. (6) The older man operates a handheld vacuum cleaner on the carpet near the sofa as the young man enters the frame from the right carrying a bag. (7) The three sit together on the sofa; the younger pair present the father with several red and white supplement bottles. (8) Close-up shots feature Move Free supplement packaging and a white tablet being removed from a bottle. (9) A 3D CGI animation of a human skeleton is overlaid on the man as he swallows the tablet, highlighting joint areas. (10) The woman uses a marker to write on a blue snack bag, which the group then playfully places on the father's head as he smiles and gives a thumbs-up gesture.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal female and male voices introduce the father over a bright, upbeat acoustic guitar BGM. (2) A loud, broadband static burst (SFX) signals a visual scene change. (3) Female narration takes over with a friendly, narrative tone as subtle electronic UI clicks punctuate the father's remote usage. (4) A metallic 'clink' SFX occurs as the lightbulb is twisted, followed by a sharp vocal warning from the female speaker and a calm response from the father. (5) Audible rustling of cardboard and heavy plastic bags as the father lifts a box. (6) A sharp door latch click and a soft wooden closing sound occur. (7) A high-pitched, steady mechanical whirring sound of a vacuum motor dominates the mix for several seconds. (8) All voices merge into an energetic promotional delivery with synchronized 'pop' and 'rattling' sound effects for the supplement packaging. (9) Final phase features multiple overlapping voices cheering and laughing, with a rhythmic swell in BGM volume to a high-arousal finish.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Move Free joint supplements by illustrating a father's hardworking and stoic nature, subsequently presenting the product as an essential health gift to support his physical mobility.
